zh: 文档里带单位的数值不再进闸门：`scripts/doc-numbers.mjs` 留着按需运行（`npm run docs:numbers`），lint 不再核对它，`docs/STYLE.md` 里与样式表逐字对应的几何与时长因此不再让推送失败。
en: A number with a unit in a document is no longer a gate: `scripts/doc-numbers.mjs` stays for running on demand (`npm run docs:numbers`), and lint no longer checks it, so the geometry and timing in `docs/STYLE.md` that mirror the stylesheets no longer fail a push.
